meta.title: Solar Installer Grenchen & Solothurn — precisely planned | DoubleA Solar
meta.description: Swiss photovoltaic specialist based in Grenchen: solar systems, battery storage, EV charging and subsidy advice in Solothurn, Bern and across Switzerland. With solar calculator, transparent quotes and long-term monitoring.

services.title: Services
services.lead: One system, one point of contact: from site analysis through to operation.

items.title: Site analysis
items.description: Roof area, orientation, shading and structure checked on site.

items.title: Planning & sizing
items.description: System concept based on your consumption profile, heat pump and electric mobility.

items.title: Subsidies & administration
items.description: Pronovo one-off subsidy, cantonal programmes and permits and notifications: we handle the paperwork.

items.title: Installation & grid connection
items.description: Mounting, electrical installation and commissioning with safety certificate (SiNa).

items.title: Battery storage & self-consumption
items.description: Battery and load management sized to your load profile.

items.title: Monitoring & maintenance
items.description: Yield monitoring, visual inspection, cleaning and inverter service.
